specs.title: SW-02 SW-11: three reports link to one existing issue; ambiguous report abstains
SW-03 SW-05: exact preview approval and persisted dry-run receipt
SW-09: threshold recomputes stored predictions and preserves provider call count
ZJ-04: exact artwork served locally, uncropped and with meaningful alt text
ZJ-05 A-18: primary screens have no serious accessibility errors or document overflow
